fix.summary: HEAD a760488 is not Apply-converged. The suite and packaging gates pass, rejected policy/style suggestions remain absent, and no orchestration dependency appeared, but the authorized production-counterexample matrix was not implemented. Two direct current-HEAD probes reproduce accepted defects: FIFO evidence admission hangs instead of rejecting, and readAssistedRunV1 accepts a malformed callId. Close the existing seams and add the exact production proofs below; do not add timeouts, retries, locks, schedulers, a second tracker, raw Recorder environment policy, or style-only extraction.

classes.name: LifecycleAdmissionExclusion
classes.owner: Assisted Runner append-only lifecycle admission seam
classes.boundary: Ended, active call, reservation, and unresolved invocation admission remain mutually exclusive under races.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Existing concurrent-caller coverage does not barrier call_started-before-navigator_started, Navigator-settlement versus role reservation, or end-versus-call admission. Add production-seam barriers proving losers launch neither Navigator nor selected role and no generation follows ended.

classes.name: NavigatorDecisionInputVisibility
classes.owner: Assisted acquisition to digest-bound Navigator snapshot seam
classes.boundary: Label-policy meanings are typed, digest-bound, and visible to the active Navigator.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). The new test proves acquisition digest and snapshot fields only; it never activates Navigator or observes its actual typed snapshot input. Add that production-runtime assertion for both mappings.

classes.name: TrackerNullBodyNormalization
classes.boundary: GitHub null parent and child bodies become zero-byte sealed evidence.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). The test substitutes a mock GitHub transport and covers only a parent. Exercise createGhJsonTransportV1 with real-shaped null parent and child responses through acquisition.

classes.name: EvidenceAdmissionContainment
classes.owner: Assisted evidence admission and Navigator loader seam
classes.boundary: Evidence IDs, regular bounded descriptor reads, immutable bytes, and capability-contained handles are enforced.
classes.disposition: OPEN (implementation and proof). A direct mkfifo counterexample timed out after 2 seconds because readBoundedRegular opens a FIFO with blocking O_RDONLY before stat; it does not reject. Repair this seam without a timeout. Add the authorized generated/duplicate ID, non-string/noncanonical path, FIFO/device, oversize, descriptor-race, handle escape, package/declaration, and post-admission mutation production matrix.

classes.name: SelectedSettlementEvidenceTruth
classes.owner: Recorder settlement to post-settlement acquisition seam
classes.boundary: Exactly one verified latest settlement artifact is readable and role-specific terminal truth is preserved.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Only Judge escalate is exercised. Add converged, continue, refusal, infrastructure, and recovered outcomes and verify each post-settlement Navigator input/artifact identity.

classes.name: RecorderArtifactAuthenticity
classes.boundary: Manifest, receipt, session, identity, length, digest, and exact child outcome joins gate settlement.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Current regression mutates only receipt length, session digest, and invocation ID. Exercise every authorized join/digest/length mutation plus children that submit a receipt and then exit nonzero or receive a signal on both live and recovery paths.

classes.name: RecoveryStateContinuity
classes.owner: Assisted Runner reservation and same-call replay seam
classes.boundary: Reservations, recovered attempts, and settled post-navigation consultations replay durably without duplicate launch.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Existing residual tests do not install the authorized crash barriers after action_reserved, after recovered publication, and after navigator_settled-before-call_completed. Add those production barriers and assert one selected identity, durable latestAttempt, and correct pre/post receipts.

classes.name: LedgerTemporaryPublicationSafety
classes.boundary: Peer temporaries are preserved, conflict losers are typed, and cleanup failures retain causality.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Peer preservation and typed conflict are covered, but no cleanup permission/I/O failure is injected. Add the required failure injection and assert the primary plus cleanup cause remains visible.

classes.name: EvidencePagingCoverage
classes.owner: Navigator evidence reader and sealed read reconstruction seam
classes.boundary: UTF-8 paging and successful-read-only bounded interval coverage agree live and reconstructed.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Current tests cover one split code point and small interval cases, but not the authorized empty, overlapping/adjacent/sparse, failed-decode, and large bounded cases through both live and readSealed reconstruction surfaces.

classes.name: NavigatorReceiptContract
classes.owner: Navigator canonical and recorded Receipt validation seam
classes.boundary: Recorded and contextual receipts are closed, identity-bound, and citation-valid, including refused defect evidence.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). New coverage calls validators directly; it does not drive malformed variants through Recorder extraction/recovery and does not establish unknown, unread, or top-level-disagreeing refused defect evidenceId rejection at those production seams.

classes.name: AssistedInputContractClosure
classes.owner: AssistedCall and public run-locator admission seam
classes.boundary: Canonical paths, environment law, positive issue IDs, and all applicable locator identities reject before I/O/publication.
classes.disposition: OPEN (implementation and proof). A direct current-HEAD probe showed readAssistedRunV1(root, validRunId, 28, '../../malformed') succeeds with latestCall:null: optional callId is never validated. Repair the shared locator admission and add the full TS/CLI matrix for malformed UUIDs, roots, parent/child values, traversal/coercible paths, and environment unset collisions before filesystem, ledger, or spawn effects.

classes.name: SchemaContractParity
classes.owner: Published JSON schemas and runtime schema exports
classes.boundary: Actual schema consumers accept every valid role/status variant and reject invalid phase/variant/extra-property combinations equivalently to runtime validators.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). The exports now reference the published schemas, but no test executes either schema through the actual consumer; existing tests only inspect packaging or call handwritten validators. Add the authorized behavioral parity matrix, including cold-package imports.

classes.name: NavigatorActivationAtomicity
classes.owner: Navigator role activation and tool registration seam
classes.boundary: All activation failures are fail-closed and corrected activation commits exactly two tools.
classes.disposition: OPEN (proof). Registration positions and active-tool verification are covered, but soul, snapshot, evidence-loading, and collision failures from the authorized matrix are not exercised with prior/new active-state assertions.

classes.name: TypedMachineControlFlow
classes.owner: Assisted recovery control flow and test oracle boundary
classes.boundary: Routing uses typed state/errors rather than presentation wording.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. Current production reconciliation uses CanonicalLifecycleResult/CanonicalLifecycleTransition and AssistedLedgerConflictError; no free-text error comparison remains in the changed routing seam.
